workbook_inventory.note: Zero formula errors is not a positive result here: every calculation and scenario output is hard-coded.

material_findings.evidence: Assumptions label organic growth capex as 0.131 $B/year, but build_model.py inserts 0.131 into $M cash-flow and FCFF series instead of 131.
material_findings.impact: Correcting only this error lowers the model's DCF from $74.72/share to approximately $52.67/share (-$22.05, -29.5%).

material_findings.evidence: The workbook has no complete balance sheet. The Net Debt sheet contains one data row and mixes a $B opening balance with $M FCF, producing -$152.75B in FY2026 and -$1,074.65B by FY2030.
material_findings.impact: The required three-statement model and balance/cash/debt tie-outs are absent.

material_findings.evidence: build_model.py represents interest expense as 0.058/0.055/0.082 in a $M model, which rounds to $0.1M. The workbook therefore shows FY2025 net income $230.0M and EPS $4.06 while the memo shows $157.1M and $2.77.
material_findings.impact: The memo-to-model traceability claim fails for core earnings figures.

material_findings.evidence: The workbook manufactures historical CFO as 66% of adjusted EBITDA and shows FY2025 FCF +$138.9M. The memo says FY2025 FCF was -$69.6M before acquisitions.
material_findings.impact: The central capital-intensity thesis is contradicted by the supporting workbook.

material_findings.evidence: Artifact-tool inspection found zero Excel formula cells across all six sheets; scenarios, DCF, forecasts, totals, and weighted target are static values.
material_findings.impact: A reader cannot change an assumption and reproduce the claimed outputs.

material_findings.evidence: Rendered workbook sheets clip many labels and headers; the workbook lacks source comments, visible model checks, and standard input/formula/link conventions.
material_findings.impact: The XLSX is not PM- or analyst-ready despite the polished memo.

positive_findings: The research repository is unusually complete: 13 SEC filings, five line-numbered transcripts, peer data, eight ADRs, questions, dead ends, source hashes, and a clean tagged release.
The eight-page PDF is readable, within the page limit, leads with the recommendation, includes explicit scenario probabilities, and has a substantive confidence/limitations section.
The model self-corrected an earlier net-debt DCF unit error before shipping, showing useful cross-check behavior, but did not detect the remaining growth-capex and statement-model defects.
comparability_note: Count as SHIPPED under the historical Qwen wallstreet ship-rate convention. Do not count as a substantive finance pass. Historical entries were not uniformly audited at this depth, so this overlay must remain a separate axis until all comparators are regraded.
